name: Recommended for every TV
author: TVDeck
description: Every tweak marked Recommended: faster menus, no ad-ID tracking, Wi-Fi stays connected, and Amazon/NVIDIA data uploads off on those devices. Steps that don't fit this TV are skipped. Undo any of them on the Tweaks page.

name: Privacy & fewer ads
author: TVDeck
description: Ad-blocking DNS for every app, no ad-ID tracking, Google TV recommendation rows off, and Amazon content recognition, Sidewalk and usage uploads off. Free ad-supported apps (Pluto, Tubi) may not play with ad-blocking DNS — set Private DNS back to Default if so.

name: Speed up a slow box
author: TVDeck
description: For 1–2 GB sticks and boxes: animations off, the 2 MB Couchy launcher as the home screen, caches cleared and apps optimized. To go back: Apps → your old launcher → Make home screen. (Fire TV ignores launcher changes and keeps its own home.)

name: Home media center
author: TVDeck
description: Jellyfin, VLC and Kodi, faster menus, ad-blocking DNS.

name: Clean home screen
author: TVDeck
description: Projectivy launcher as the home screen plus Aerial Views screensaver.

name: Game streaming
author: TVDeck
description: Moonlight for streaming games from your PC with Sunshine, and the device stays awake while streaming.
